CHARLOTTE, N.C., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KAOZ TV LLC and City View Films have transitioned the reality series Tattoo Review into a full-length episodic format, documenting the daily operations of Tattoo Factory of Charlotte. Moving beyond the limitations of micro-content, the series provides an authentic look at professional body art culture, prioritizing artist-client collaboration over staged competition formats. The new show will include piercings as well as tattoos.

Prospective clients and viewers can access studio updates and service information at https://tattoofactoryofcharlotte.com

The expanded series explores the technical and personal narratives found within a high-volume studio. A primary differentiator in the new format is the inclusion of both tattoos and professional piercing services, offering a comprehensive view of the body art industry. Each episode tracks the progression from initial consultation and design to the final procedure, providing a practical resource for first-time clients and a behind-the-scenes look for enthusiasts. By focusing on the day-to-day pace of a working North Carolina studio, the production highlights the reality of the client experience.

"We are presenting the authentic, unfiltered energy of our new Charlotte tattoo studio to a wider audience through Tattoo Review," said Derek Van Cleve, owner of Tattoo Factory of Charlotte. "By moving away from staged competition tropes and focusing on the genuine connection between our artists and their clients, we are offering viewers a rare look at the dedication behind every tattoo and piercing."

Multi-platform distribution

To ensure broad accessibility, the series utilizes a strategic distribution network:

  • Digital & Social: Viewers can access content via YouTube and Facebook, with additional streaming availability on KLIPZ TV.
  • Broadcast Syndication: Full-length episodes are syndicated on KAOZ TV, connecting the production with both the local North Carolina market and a national audience.

This multi-channel approach allows viewers to engage with the series through their preferred medium, whether on social media, streaming devices, or traditional television.

releases.body:
BEIJING, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Early Spring, a workplace romance produced by Youku, Alibaba's online video platform, has reached the highest-ever ranking for a Chinese mainland drama on Netflix's Global Non-English TV list, at No. 2 for the week of Aug. 24-30. The achievement is a testament to Youku's long-term commitment to developing high-quality original content.

The 24-episode series premiered simultaneously on Youku and Netflix on Aug. 26. Despite being available for only five days during the tracking period, it recorded 2.4 million views and 21.5 million hours viewed on Netflix.

The series ranked among Netflix's weekly Top 10 in 22 markets, including Indonesia, Malaysia, Brazil, Venezuela and Qatar, and topped the weekly TV charts in China's Hong Kong and Taiwan regions, Thailand and Vietnam.

Within two days of its premiere, The Early Spring also reached No. 6 on Netflix's global daily chart and entered the daily Top 10 in 54 countries and regions. It topped the daily charts in Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, China's Hong Kong and Taiwan regions, while securing the No. 2 spot in Brazil.

The series stars Jing Boran as Luke Luan, a sharp-tongued creative director, and Sun Qian as Flora Shang, a newcomer to the corporate world. As they navigate the pressures of a fast-paced workplace, their growing relationship develops into a secret office romance.

The series' global performance comes amid a strong summer season for Youku's original dramas, underscoring the platform's sustained focus on quality-driven content. Crime thriller Unsettled Case received a 7.6 rating on Chinese review platform Douban, while mystery-adventure series The Mystic Nine surpassed 10,000 on Youku's heat index within 50 hours of its premiere. The Early Spring continued that momentum, surpassing 10,000 on the platform's heat index within three days of its premiere.

The Early Spring also follows strong international performances from previous Youku romance dramas. Hidden Love, released in 2023, appeared on Netflix's weekly charts across multiple markets for a cumulative 53 weeks, while The First Frost, released in 2025, reached No. 6 on Netflix's global daily chart and topped the rankings in China's Hong Kong and Taiwan regions, and Singapore.

About Youku

Youku is a leading online video platform in China that produces and distributes high-quality video content in a variety of content forms. Content types include original production, joint production, rights acquisition, user-generated content (UGC), professional-generated content (PGC), and live broadcast. It enables users to search, view, and share content quickly and easily across multiple devices. Youku is driven by a dedication to excellent content. It is committed to providing users with high-quality premium content and exceptional audio-visual experience through the synergy of quality content and digital technology.

releases.title: 2025 NFL Season Marked a Historic Step Forward for Sony + NFL Partnership with Capture of 130,000 Images by The AP, 1,100+ Hours of Broadcast Television, Deployment of 2,300+ Coach's Headsets, and Collaboration on 600+ Officiating Events
releases.body:
Building on more than a decade of partnership, Sony + NFL are moving into the 2026 Season maintaining focus on advancing the game and laying a strong foundation for future innovation

SAN DIEGO, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sony Electronics Inc. and the National Football League (NFL) today shared an update summarizing the measurable impact Sony's technologies have had across many of NFL's most critical gameday operations and communications.

During the 2025 season, Sony's broadcast cameras captured over 1,100 hours of NFL action across over 300 games, while Sony's Alpha™ lineup of interchangeable lens cameras enabled The Associated Press to capture more than 130,000 images. The 2025 season marked a historic milestone as the first full season of Sony's Hawk-Eye video replay and measurement technologies and Sony NFL Coach's Headsets, supporting 630 officiating events and more than 2,300 Coach's Headsets used by all 32 NFL teams with zero hardware failures over the entire season. Sony and the NFL will continue innovating to further enhance game operations and shape the future of football.

Seeing the Game Like Never Before 

Sony imaging technologies help bring every NFL game to fans around the world. From live game coverage and replay to sideline photography and in-venue production, Sony's professional cameras, accessories, and imaging solutions provide broadcasters with the speed, clarity, and reliability needed to capture football's biggest moments.

Throughout the 2025 season, Sony imaging technologies supported the league's more than 1,100 hours of live game broadcasts across its major broadcast partners. Hundreds of Sony cameras and imaging solutions support broadcast production across every NFL game, with more than 175 Sony cameras deployed on and around the field during Super Bowl LX alone. Sony's high frame rate (HFR) cameras captured detailed slow-motion replays that brought fans even closer to the action.

Beyond the broadcast, Sony's continued partnership with The Associated Press enabled their team of sports photojournalists to utilize the most advanced Alpha™ camera and lens technologies, capturing over 130,000 memorable images throughout the season. 

Sony's Beyond Sports innovations are helping drive fan engagement in entirely new ways by transforming real-time tracking data from Sony's Hawk-Eye Innovations and the NFL's Next Gen Stats powered by AWS into an immersive, animated viewing experience. During the 2025 season, its technology powered Monsters Funday Football, ESPN and Disney's animated Monday Night Football alternate broadcast, contributing to ESPN's highest Monday Night Football Week 14 audience ever in the ESPN era of the iconic franchise. These alternate broadcasts create new ways for broadcasters to tell the story of the game while engaging fans and reaching new audiences.

A Faster, More Precise Game Experience

Sony's Hawk-Eye virtual measurement system has quickly become an integral part of NFL officiating, helping officials make first down measurements faster. Available across all NFL games, including preseason, regular season and postseason matchups, Sony's Hawk-Eye technology supported 21 virtual measurements, completing each measurement in nearly half the average time as the traditional chain measurement.

This included several high-profile measurement situations, including two critical measurements during the Buffalo vs. Jacksonville playoff game, confirming first downs by margins of just two and four inches, respectively.

Sony's Hawk-Eye technology also supports replay operations by providing officials and fans with additional camera angles and real-time visual data throughout the game. During the 2025 season, 360 Hawk-Eye boundary line cameras were installed across every NFL stadium (12 in each), including international venues, supporting 322 replay reviews and 141 replay assists. This provided officials with additional visual perspectives while helping broadcasters and fans better understand critical plays.

"Our partnership with Sony is rooted in a shared commitment to strengthening the game through innovation," said Tracie Rodburg, Senior Vice President of Global Partnerships at the NFL. "From officiating and coaching communications to game operations, Sony's technologies have delivered meaningful results and helped us provide a more consistent experience for officials, coaches, players and fans. As we look ahead, we're excited to continue building on that success together." 

"For more than a decade, we've worked alongside the NFL to develop technologies that solve real challenges and support some of the most important moments in the game," said Theresa Alesso, President, Imaging Products and Solutions Americas, Sony Electronics. "The results from the first season reflect what's possible when innovation is built in collaboration with the people who use it. We're excited to continue evolving that partnership and exploring what's next together."

Enabling Clear Communication Across the Sideline

Sony's NFL Coach's Headsets completed their first full season supporting all 32 NFL teams, delivering industry-leading noise cancellation for clear communication in some of the loudest environments in professional sports. With more than 2,300 headsets deployed across the league and more than 1,100 hours of gameday communication without a single hardware failure, the system provided coaches with the reliability, comfort, and clarity they need to make decisions throughout every game while supporting consistent game operations across the league.

"Sideline communication is one of the most critical parts of gameday operations, and Sony's NFL Coach's Headsets have exceeded our expectations in their first season," said Kimberly Fields, Senior Vice President of Football Business & Innovation Strategy at the NFL. "The technology has delivered the reliability, clarity, and consistency our coaches need, and we're excited to continue evolving the partnership."

Looking Ahead

From next-generation broadcast cameras to state-of-the-art optical tracking technologies, Sony innovations are helping create new viewing angles, deliver richer in-stadium experiences and provide officials and broadcasters with more powerful tools than ever before.

New broadcast technologies, including Sony's AI-enabled Pant-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) cameras, are expanding creative production possibilities by capturing unique perspectives from locations that were previously difficult to access while maintaining seamless color matching with Sony's system cameras. Across stadiums, Sony imaging technologies are also supporting new in-venue experiences, from producing highlight reels for videoboards to providing officials and teams with additional replay perspectives.

At the same time, Sony and the NFL continue to evolve Sony's Hawk-Eye tracking technologies to further enhance officiating and game administration. Planned advancements include expanded use of SkeleTRACK data and increased automation within the virtual measurement workflow to streamline operations, reduce manual inputs, expedite turnaround times and further improve the precision and consistency of virtual measurements, while continuing to evaluate future innovations such as ball spotting.

As the partnership continues to evolve, Sony and the NFL remain committed to continuing to innovate together, further build on this momentum, and help shape the future of football.

About Sony Electronics Inc.

Sony Electronics is a subsidiary of Sony Corporation of America and an affiliate of Sony Group Corporation, one of the most comprehensive entertainment companies in the world, with a portfolio that encompasses electronics, music, motion pictures, mobile, gaming, robotics and financial services. Headquartered in San Diego, California, Sony Electronics is a leader in electronics for the consumer and professional markets. Operations include research and development, engineering, sales, marketing, distribution and customer service. Sony Electronics creates products that innovate and inspire generations, such as the award-winning Alpha Interchangeable Lens Cameras and revolutionary high-resolution audio products. Sony is also a leading manufacturer of end-to-end solutions from 4K professional broadcast and A/V equipment to industry leading 4K and 8K Ultra HD TVs.

releases.title: FOX NEWS MEDIA TO PRESENT SPECIAL MULTIPLATFORM PROGRAMMING COMMEMORATING THE 25TH ANNIVERSARY OF SEPTEMBER 11TH
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Media will honor the 25th anniversary of the September 11th, 2001 terrorist attacks with extensive multiplatform special programming. On Friday, September 11th and in the days leading up to it, network personalities and correspondents will present commemorative packages and interviews while reporting live from locations across New York, Pennsylvania and Washington, D.C.

During the week of September 7th, FOX News Channel's (FNC) signature morning show FOX & Friends (6-9 AM/ET) will broadcast live from several locations and feature interviews with guests about their experiences 25 years ago. Starting on Monday, co-host Steve Doocy, who was broadcasting live alongside co-host Brian Kilmeade on the morning of the attacks, will host the program's flagship "Breakfast with Friends" series live from the historic O'Hara's Pub in downtown Manhattan just two blocks from Ground Zero. Doocy will travel to Washington, D.C. on Tuesday and speak with Tunnels to Towers Foundation chairman and CEO Frank Siller, as the Steel Across America tour, a historic coast-to-coast campaign honoring those who sacrificed their lives on 9/11, arrives at the White House. Throughout the show on Thursday, Doocy will broadcast live from Shanksville, Pennsylvania, the crash site of United Airlines Flight 93. 

On Friday, September 11th, special coverage will commence with FOX & Friends co-hosts Kilmeade, Ainsley Earhardt and Lawrence Jones broadcasting live from the Hyatt House in Jersey City, overlooking the New York City (NYC) skyline, while Doocy will contribute live from Ground Zero. America's Newsroom (9-11 AM/ET) co-anchors Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino will broadcast live from Brookfield Place overlooking the World Trade Center campus in downtown Manhattan. The program will carry the live reading of the victims' names from the National September 11 Memorial & Museum. From 11 AM - 3 PM/ET, The Faulkner Focus (11-12 PM/ET), Outnumbered (12-1 PM/ET), and America Reports (1-3 PM/ET) will all feature special segments and interviews with a wide range of guests including families of 9/11 victims, military officials, 9/11 survivors, and founders/CEOs of 9/11-related foundations. Martha MacCallum, host of The Story (3-4 PM/ET), will report live from the Hyatt House and feature interviews with Cardinal Timothy Dolan, the New York Police Department (NYPD) co-chief chaplain, and Jessica Tisch, the NYPD Commissioner. Additionally, The Will Cain Show (4-5 PM/ET) will honor the anniversary with guests who will recount their experiences on 9/11.

Contributing to coverage throughout the day will be FNC senior correspondent Eric Shawn, who reported from Ground Zero on the day of the attacks, live from downtown Manhattan and correspondent Alexis McAdams from Shanksville. Chief national security correspondent Jennifer Griffin and senior White House correspondent Peter Doocy will report from the Pentagon and the White House, respectively. 

FOX Nation will debut two new specials exploring the impacts of the 9/11 attacks 25 years later. Premiering on September 4th, Paul Mauro's Notes from Ground Zero spotlights FNC contributor and former NYPD Inspector Paul Mauro – who was working the morning of 9/11 – as he returns to Ground Zero for the first time in 25 years. Mauro, who scribbled down notes in the days following the attacks, reunites with fellow officers and shares never-before-seen photos and video. On September 8th, FOX Nation will launch Born on 9/11: 25 Years with Harris Faulkner, exploring the lives of people born on September 11th, 2001, the hope they brought to the country, and where they are now. The platform will also livestream the official ceremonies at the NYC memorial site and the Pentagon on September 11th. 

FOX Business Network's (FBN) Liz Claman, anchor of The Claman Countdown (weekdays 3-4 PM/ET), will speak exclusively with Brandon and Kyle Lutnick, the Chairman and Executive Vice Chairman of Cantor Fitzgerald, on September 10th to commemorate the 658 Cantor Fitzgerald employees lost in the 9/11 attacks and to preview the firm's annual BGC Charity Day. On September 11th, Claman will feature an interview with founder and CEO of Silverstein Properties Larry Silverstein from the World Trade Center, which he helped rebuild following the 9/11 attacks. She will also speak with then-U.S. Senator and former New Jersey Governor Jon Corzine (D-NJ), and former JP Morgan Chase CEO Bill Harrison as they reflect on the impact of the day. 

FOX News Digital will provide day-of coverage of the commemorations at Ground Zero, the Pentagon and Shanksville, including live updates, coordinated video and social content and live stream embeds from all three ceremonies. The platform will feature interviews with Elizabeth L. Hillman, president and CEO of the National September 11 Memorial & Museum, and former Navy SEAL Robert O'Neill, who participated in the 2011 raid that killed Osama bin Laden. Throughout the day, FOX News Digital will publish multiple retrospective and feature stories focused on survivors, first responders, victims' families and those carrying the legacy of 9/11 forward 25 years later. The platform will also offer political and policy coverage, including reporting on how homeland security has evolved since the attacks. Additionally, the platform will publish a "Never Forget" archival photo retrospective, including a look at how Ground Zero and the lower Manhattan skyline have changed since the attacks. 

FOX News Audio will present extensive coverage of the anniversary. Throughout the day on September 11th, FOX News Headlines 24/7 on Sirius XM will provide the latest updates on ceremonies and events every 15 minutes. Leading up to the commemoration, FOX News Radio (FNR) will share two weeks of daily one-minute feature reports, each spotlighting someone personally affected by the 9/11 attacks. FNR will also offer breaking news coverage of the NYC memorial ceremony, featuring reporting from Ground Zero. The Brian Kilmeade Show, Fox Across America with Jimmy Failla and The Guy Benson Show will interview guests and newsmakers impacted by the attacks. On YouTube, The Brian Kilmeade Show will provide access to some of Kilmeade's most notable 9/11 interviews, and FNR affiliates will be offered an anniversary special from Kilmeade that reflects on how America has evolved since then.

FOX News Podcasts will release specialized coverage in remembrance as well. The FOX News Rundown podcast will mark the anniversary by delivering a week of immersive content across its platform. The FOX News Rundown: Evening Edition will anchor the programming by providing personal accounts of survival and exploring the lasting geopolitical and cultural impacts of the attacks. The FOX Business Rundown and FOX News From Washington will examine the quarter-century legacy through dedicated economic, policy, and national security lenses. On Perino on Politics, Perino will sit down with key insiders of the Bush administration who helped navigate the crisis from the center of power, including Chief Photographer Eric Draper, Presidential Speechwriter John McConnell and Director of Media Affairs Jeanie Mamo. Additionally, the host of Searching for Heroes, FNC's Benjamin Hall, will sit down with guests whose lives were impacted by the attacks, sharing stories of survival, sacrifice and resilience. Finally, FOX News Podcasts has launched an eight-part documentary series entitled FOX News Rewind: 9/11, building upon previous coverage, this updated edition features new reporting, examining the events leading up to the attacks, the courage of those who survived and responded, as well as the aftermath. The series will feature commentators such as Brit Hume, Steve Doocy, and Kilmeade. Bill Hemmer will host the finale of the series from the National September 11 Memorial & Museum where he will be joined by Elizabeth L. Hillman and other guests for a forward-looking dialogue on memory, endurance, and legacy.

releases.body:
MIAMI, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ViendoMovies, the Spanish–language PayTV channel owned by SOMOSTV (a company chaired by Luis Villanueva and part of SOMOS Group), which programs the best contemporary films produced in Spanish, 24 hours a day and without commercial interruptions, celebrates during the month of September 2026 the twentieth (20th) anniversary of a space that showcases and promotes the cinema that has impacted audiences around the world. ViendoMovies commemorates an outstanding trajectory in Spanish–language television in the United States and Puerto Rico presenting modern and exclusive films, originally produced in Spanish, with high production values, big–screen quality, and the most popular talent from all Spanish–speaking countries. The channel is included in the Hispanic channel packages of major cable and telecommunications companies, strengthening entertainment offerings for the Latino community.

ViendoMovies was launched on September 5, 2006, with a premium profile, elegant on–air presence, and a high–quality graphic package. The channel programs films in High Definition and first–window PayTV releases, not available on other channels or platforms—an important option in times of redundancy in title distribution. With its extensive library, the channel offers, in addition to regular premieres, genre or talent cycles, functioning as a promotional space for modern Spanish–language cinema.

ViendoMovies includes closed captioning in English and Spanish and coverage of events where Spanish–language cinema participates, such as the Oscars, Goya Awards, Ariel Awards, and festivals in Huelva, San Sebastián, Miami, Chicago, and others. The channel includes a significant offering of Video On Demand (VOD) titles, allowing subscribers to enjoy great films whenever they choose.

Before the arrival of ViendoMovies, Spanish–language cinema had limited representation in the market, despite the production capacity of countries with well–developed film industries such as Colombia, Chile, Peru, the Dominican Republic, Argentina, and Spain, among others. The cinema from these countries on the channel, combined with the significant presence of Mexican cinema (for the largest Latino community), provides a balanced offering of origins and genres and represents an important source of revenue for the Spanish–language film industry, supporting its growth and sustainability.

ViendoMovies celebrates national holidays and U.S. festivities, fostering integration and meeting the needs of a community that goes to the movies an average of 3.3 times a year—compared to Asians (2.9) and Whites (2.3)—and represents 24% of box office sales despite being 19% of the population.

Luis Villanueva, President and CEO of SOMOS Group, stated: "Twenty years in such a competitive and dynamic market is an achievement worthy of celebration. Our team established a position that is a source of pride for us, our clients, and our audience. We deliver a channel of the highest quality, competitive with the best, in the most developed television market. Cinema is one of the entertainment options most preferred by Latinos, and with ViendoMovies we enjoy modern productions representative of a cutting–edge industry. We will continue this important mission, which connects us with our roots and language."

ViendoMovies celebrates more than an anniversary. These are 20 years of permanence, evolution, and connection with its audience as a destination to enjoy the best films originally produced in Spanish. releases.body:
IQSTEL has launched the IDILIO TV commercial sales pipeline with mobile operators as part of its strategy to build scalable, high-margin recurring digital revenue

IDILIO TV is backed by a $5 million seed round led by a16z Speedrun, with Goodwater Capital, WndrCo and Nubank founder David Vélez participating

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) today announced a corporate objective to establish mobile-operator distribution channels capable of reaching a potential audience of approximately 40 million mobile users by the end of the second quarter of 2027 for the microdrama entertainment service offered through its strategic partnership with IDILIO TV.

The initiative is built directly on infrastructure IQSTEL already owns. The Company maintains commercial relationships with more than 600 telecommunications operators across 24 countries, whose networks collectively provide potential access to approximately 2.3 billion end users. Those relationships were established to carry voice, SMS and data traffic. IQSTEL now intends to use the same commercial channel as a distribution pipeline for premium digital content — creating a route to monetize an existing platform in higher-margin, recurring-revenue services.

The Company's 40 million-user objective refers to the combined potential audience represented by the mobile operators it targets for distribution agreements. It does not represent 40 million existing or guaranteed paying subscribers.

From Network Operator to Content Distribution Platform

IQSTEL spent years building a multinational telecommunications footprint: interconnection agreements, technical integrations, billing relationships and commercial trust with carriers on five continents. That footprint has historically been monetized through wholesale voice and messaging — high-volume, low-margin businesses in which IQSTEL competes on scale and execution.

The IDILIO TV partnership is intended to demonstrate a different use for the same asset. A carrier relationship that can terminate SMS traffic can also bundle, market and bill for a subscription entertainment service. IQSTEL's existing operator integrations, commercial relationships and billing rails are expected to support the distribution and billing capabilities required to commercialize the service. What changes is the product moving across that infrastructure — and the potential margin profile associated with it.

"This initiative demonstrates how IQSTEL can transform the global telecommunications platform we have built over many years into a commercialization engine for higher-margin digital products," said Leandro Iglesias, CEO of IQSTEL. "We are combining an attractive product, experienced digital leadership and established operator relationships. Together, these elements can create a powerful foundation for recurring revenue and long-term shareholder value."

"The IDILIO TV rollout is not an isolated product launch," Iglesias continued. "It is an example of the broader opportunity to distribute multiple digital services through infrastructure and commercial relationships IQSTEL already has in place."

How the Distribution Pipeline Works

Through integrations with participating mobile operators, IDILIO TV may be offered through direct carrier billing, standalone subscriptions and value-added mobile service bundles.

Direct carrier billing is intended to support the model at scale. Rather than requiring a credit card, app-store account or separate payment relationship, the subscription charge may appear on the customer's existing mobile bill.

For Spanish-speaking markets in Latin America and diaspora communities where card penetration may be uneven, simplifying the payment process could reduce barriers to subscription while using billing infrastructure already operated by participating mobile carriers.

For participating operators, the service could create an incremental revenue opportunity and customer-retention tool without requiring the operator to produce original content. For IQSTEL, each executed agreement could expand the potential audience, increase brand visibility and support subscriber growth—creating a possible compounding or "snowball effect" as operators are added

Experience Scaling Digital Audiences

The initiative will be led by Jorge Becerra, CEO of IQSTEL Digital, who brings more than 25 years of experience developing products and digital services across the media, advertising, television, and digital-services industries, including prior experience building and reaching audiences of approximately 100 million users.

"Reaching a potential audience of 40 million mobile users is an ambitious goal, but it is grounded in experience," said Becerra. "According to Omdia, microdramas are demonstrating strong monetization potential, with more than 60% of global revenue generated through subscriptions and transactional payments. By combining this market opportunity with IQSTEL's global telecommunications platform and full organizational support, we believe we have a powerful foundation for scaling IDILIO TV worldwide."

"We have already launched the IDILIO TV commercial sales pipeline with mobile operators, but this is only the tip of the iceberg," Becerra continued. "Our broader business plan is already underway, and we expect to unveil additional services, partnerships and growth initiatives in the coming months. The 40 million-user objective is an important first milestone, but it is only the beginning of what we believe IQSTEL Digital can build."

A Scalable, High-Margin Recurring-Revenue Model

The model is designed to create a scalable source of recurring revenue for IQSTEL.

For illustrative purposes only, at an assumed penetration rate of 1.25% of a 40 million-user potential audience, the service would reach approximately 500,000 gross paying subscribers by the end of 2027. The gross subscriber count does not include churned subscribers.

Because premium digital content is expected to generate substantially higher margins than traditional wholesale telecommunications services, IQSTEL believes this model could make a meaningful contribution to revenue diversification, margin expansion and long-term profitability.

The 1.25% penetration rate is an assumption used solely to illustrate the arithmetic of the model. This penetration rate does not account for subscriber churn. It is not derived from executed agreements, existing subscriber data or Company forecasts. Actual subscriber adoption, pricing, revenue and profitability will depend on executed operator agreements, commercial terms, market conditions and consumer response. This illustration is not financial guidance or a revenue forecast.

Why Now: A Growing Global Market With a Language Gap

Microdramas—also known as vertical dramas or micronovelas—are serialized fictional programs created specifically for smartphones. Episodes generally run between one and three minutes, are filmed vertically and use fast-paced storytelling and cliffhangers to encourage viewers to continue watching.

The format brings the emotional intensity of the Latin American telenovela tradition to the way consumers now use their phones: frequently, vertically and in short sessions throughout the day.

Although the microdrama category has expanded rapidly, a significant portion of its commercial development has been concentrated in China. IQSTEL believes this creates an opportunity to serve a Spanish-language market that remains comparatively underserved.

Spanish is spoken by more than 630 million people worldwide, including highly connected diaspora communities that maintain strong relationships with their language, culture and entertainment traditions. IQSTEL believes the combination of authentic Spanish-language content and carrier-level distribution can address both the content and distribution components of this opportunity.

IDILIO TV: Institutional Backing and an Operating Platform

IDILIO TV closed a $5 million seed round led by a16z Speedrun, Andreessen Horowitz's media and entertainment accelerator, with participation from Goodwater Capital, Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, and Nubank founder David Vélez individually.

IDILIO TV was co-founded by CEO Gabriela Tafur Standford MBA and CTO Esteban Ramírez, who holds an MBA and a master's degree in computer science from MIT. Its productions are developed by professionals with extensive experience in Colombian and Latin American television.

Its series and executives have received prestigious awards, including the 42nd India Catalina Awards at the 2026 Cartagena International Film Festival (FICCI), where its series Llamado en la Madrugada (Call in the Early Hours) was recognized as Best Vertical Fiction Series.

According to IDILIO TV, the platform has surpassed 2 million downloads, availability in more than 120 countries and 49 original series launched. Its content is available on iOS and Android devices.

Supporting IQSTEL's EBITDA and Margin Expansion Strategy

The IDILIO TV initiative forms part of IQSTEL's broader EBITDA and margin expansion strategy, focused on introducing higher-margin services—including premium digital content, fintech, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and digital health—through the Company's existing global telecommunications ecosystem. IQSTEL believes that expanding its portfolio of scalable, recurring-revenue digital services can improve its revenue mix and, if successfully commercialized, contribute to long-term profitability and EBITDA growth.

IQSTEL reported preliminary, unaudited revenue of approximately $207 million for the first half of 2026, compared with approximately $130 million in the prior-year period. These preliminary figures are subject to completion of the Company's customary review procedures and may change.

The Company views the initial IDILIO TV sales pipeline and the 40 million-user audience objective as the first application of a distribution capability it intends to use repeatedly.

IDILIO TV is a mobile-first entertainment platform producing premium vertical microdramas for Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide. Founded in Colombia and led by CEO and Co-Founder Gabriela Tafur and CTO and Co-Founder Esteban Ramírez, IDILIO TV combines Latin American storytelling with proprietary mobile technology and a mix of subscription, virtual-currency, advertising, and brand-partnership monetization. According to the company, IDILIO TV has surpassed 2 million downloads, and distribution across more than 120 countries, with a catalog of more than 49 original series. For more information, visit www.idilio.tv/en.

About IQSTEL Inc.

IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) is a global telecommunications and technology company operating through two core business divisions: Telecom and Digital Services. The Telecom Division is the foundation of IQSTEL's global platform, operating across 24 countries with more than 600 telecommunications carrier interconnections and delivering international voice, SMS, messaging, and connectivity solutions to some of the world's largest telecom operators and enterprise customers. Through these customer relationships, IQSTEL's platform has the potential to reach approximately 2.3 billion end users worldwide. Building on this global infrastructure and commercial reach, the Digital Services Division is focused on higher-margin technology solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Communications, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Digital Health, Enterprise Automation, and Content Services. Built through nearly two decades of organic growth and strategic acquisitions, IQSTEL is leveraging the scale and reach of its Telecom business to accelerate the growth of Digital Services and drive its next phase of revenue and Adjusted EBITDA expansion.

Cricket TV is now available for early access with full commercial launch of the service expected later this year at https://tv.cricket.com.au.

"We're excited to extend our partnership with Eluvio as we continue to grow Cricket TV and make Australian cricket more accessible to fans around the world," said Dan Allan, Senior Content Manager, Broadcast at Cricket Australia. "Cricket TV brings live matches and some of the best moments from our archive together in one place for fans around the world. Eluvio has been a fantastic partner throughout the process, helping us deliver a high-quality viewing experience while giving us the flexibility to keep evolving the platform. During the early access period, Cricket TV has already reached viewers in more than 40 countries, highlighting the strong global interest in Australian cricket."

"We're honored to have extended our relationship with Cricket Australia, not only to serve their fans with live matches, but also to serve as a model for other sports organizations looking for the most efficient and cost-effective way to deliver protected sports content with the quality today's global viewers deserve," said Michelle Munson, CEO and Co-founder, Eluvio. "With one Fabric, sports rights holders can unlock dark markets and monetize live and VOD and leverage frame-accurate inline AI, without file copies— all at a fraction of legacy costs while retaining full control of their customers' experience and viewer analytics."

Cricket TV provides a white-label browser, mobile, and connected TV application to its viewers built using the Eluvio Media Wallet platform (full turnkey OTT Suite). Cricket TV relies on Eluvio's Content Fabric to receive live matches or archival source feeds and dynamically ingests, transcodes, publishes and generates just-in-time streaming output directly to viewers. Streaming is provided at full source resolution, including HD and 4K, with dynamic automatic adaptation to the user's available bandwidth with low latency HLS/DASH delivery, unlimited multi-view, "zero-copy" live-to-VoD and fast DVR playback. The platform also provides subscriptions, pay-per-view, and/or ad-supported monetization, while providing end-to-end content security and anti-piracy protection including strong encryption, DRM, forensic watermarking, and dynamic authorization per-offering including geo blocking and rights control. All features are built-in allowing for a hyper-efficient, tamper-proof distribution, fast and easy purchasing, and on-screen authenticity proofs for the viewer.

In addition, the Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE) and AI-assisted tools provide frame-accurate, in-line analysis, indexing, and search, composition, and transformation such as live vertical video, all without file copies or re-transcoding. Finally, Eluvio Content Analytics provides complete transparency of source-to-viewer audience, QoS, and sales analytics. Full details about Eluvio's technical capabilities and benefits can be found at https://eluv.io

NEW YORK, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) ("IQSTEL" or the "Company"), a multinational technology company providing telecommunications, fintech, AI-powered communications, cybersecurity, content, and digital infrastructure services, today announced that its subsidiary IQSTEL Digital (www.iqsteldigital.com) has entered into a strategic distribution partnership with IDILIO TV (www.idilio.tv/en), a Colombian mobile entertainment platform specializing in short-form vertical microdramas.

The partnership pairs IDILIO TV's content library, audience traction, and mobile technology with IQSTEL's telecommunications infrastructure and mobile-operator relationships, with the objective of building a recurring-revenue digital entertainment business serving Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide.

Why This Partnership, and Why Now

Short-form vertical drama — commonly called "microdrama" — is among the fastest-growing categories in digital entertainment. The format originated in China and, according to industry reporting, generated approximately $11 billion in global revenue in 2024, growing roughly 35% that year following a 268% increase in 2023. Chinese-language platforms are reported to account for roughly 83% of that revenue, leaving Spanish-language content — addressing more than 630 million speakers worldwide — comparatively underserved. (according to industry reports)

IDILIO TV was built to serve that gap with original Latin American content rather than dubbed imports. IQSTEL brings the distribution layer: commercial relationships with more than 600 telecom operators across 21 countries, and the billing and integration infrastructure required to place a consumer digital service inside a mobile operator's subscriber offering.

"IDILIO TV brings a proven product, compelling content, technology, and audience engagement. IQSTEL brings the operator relationships and distribution infrastructure needed to scale it. That combination can transform a successful digital product into a global recurring revenue business." said Leandro Iglesias, President and CEO of IQSTEL.

How the Distribution Model Works

IQSTEL Digital intends to distribute IDILIO TV through participating mobile operators using several complementary monetization paths:

  • Direct-carrier billing, under which a subscriber's charges appear on an existing mobile bill, removing the payment-card friction that limits digital subscription adoption in many Latin American and emerging markets.
  • Standalone and bundled subscriptions, in which operators package the service with existing data or entertainment plans as a differentiator.

Unlike a one-time content licensing transaction, this model is designed to generate revenue monthly for as long as subscribers remain active. Each new mobile-operator agreement can provide access to an additional subscriber base; as distribution expands, subscriber growth can support additional content, marketing, and geographic expansion.

IQSTEL's commercial telecommunications relationships extend across an ecosystem of operators whose combined networks serve an estimated 2.3 billion end users. This figure describes the aggregate reach of IQSTEL's operator relationships and is not a projection of potential subscribers for this service.

"Every new operator opens a door to another potential subscriber base, and every retained subscriber can contribute recurring revenue," Iglesias said. "Rather than building a global distribution network from the ground up, we intend to activate the relationships and infrastructure already present across IQSTEL's platform."

An Operating Platform with Institutional Backing

IDILIO TV launched its iOS and Android applications in late 2025 and has scaled rapidly. According to IDILIO TV, the platform has achieved:

  • More than 2 million downloads
  • Distribution across more than 120 countries and more than 400,000 social-media followers.
  • A catalog of 49+ original series and 2,450+ short-form episodes, in Spanish, English, and Portuguese.
  • Production of approximately two to four new series per month.

In June 2026, IDILIO TV announced the close of a $5 million seed financing led by a16z Speedrun, the Andreessen Horowitz accelerator focused on media and entertainment, with participation from Goodwater Capital, WndrCo — the investment firm co-founded by media executive Jeffrey Katzenberg — and David Vélez, founder of Nubank, investing individually.

Episodes generally run between one and three minutes and span romance, thriller, suspense, mystery, crime, and revenge — genres suited to mobile viewing and serialized engagement. The company produces content using a data-driven development process, testing series concepts with audiences before committing to full production.

"Microdramas are changing how audiences discover entertainment," said Jorge Becerra, CEO of IQSTEL Digital. "The format is mobile-native, highly engaging, and ideally suited for telecommunications distribution. IDILIO TV already has the content and audience. IQSTEL can provide the commercial channels needed to pursue much greater scale."

Leadership and Creative Origin

IDILIO TV was co-founded by Chief Executive Officer Gabriela Tafur, a Stanford-educated attorney, and Chief Technology Officer Esteban Ramírez, who holds an MBA and a master's degree in computer science from MIT.

The platform draws on Colombia's long track record in producing and exporting dramas and telenovelas. With creative influences from Colombia, Miami, and Mexico, its stories combine Latin American cultural specificity with themes that travel — love, ambition, betrayal, revenge, and redemption. Latin American and Colombian communities are well established across the United States, Europe, and Asia, and their cultural and linguistic ties create a natural international audience for authentic Spanish-language entertainment.

"Colombia has already proven that its stories can travel," Becerra said. "IDILIO TV brings that creative legacy into a mobile-first, globally scalable format."

"Our stories are rooted in Latin America, but the emotions are universal," said Gabriela Tafur, CEO and Co-Founder of IDILIO TV. "IQSTEL Digital provides the telecommunications relationships and infrastructure needed to reach Spanish-speaking audiences wherever they live. Together, we have a real opportunity to build a scalable and sustainable global entertainment business."

Creating Value Across the Ecosystem

  • Mobile operators gain a differentiated digital service designed to support subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention, and a new billing-based revenue share.
  • Subscribers gain convenient access to culturally relevant, mobile-first entertainment, payable through an existing mobile account.
  • IDILIO TV gains international distribution and new subscriber-acquisition channels without building operator relationships market by market.
  • IQSTEL gains the opportunity to build a scalable recurring revenue stream with potential EBITDA contribution, consistent with its strategy of monetizing higher-margin digital services across its existing carrier network.

Financial Context and Outlook

IQSTEL reported preliminary net revenue of approximately $207 million for the first six months of 2026, compared to approximately $130 million in the same period of 2025. The Company has stated a fiscal year 2026 revenue target of $430 million and has described a strategic focus on expanding EBITDA through higher-margin digital services.

"For years we invested in building a global telecommunications platform — 21 countries, more than 600 operator relationships, and the billing and integration infrastructure that connects them," said Leandro Iglesias, President and CEO of IQSTEL. "This partnership is exactly how we intend to monetize that network. We are not building new distribution here; we are placing a digital service into channels that already exist and already carry traffic every day. If we execute, that is what turns infrastructure we have already built into recurring, higher-margin.."

Subject to operator agreements, technical integrations, pricing, subscriber adoption, and market execution, IQSTEL believes the partnership represents a meaningful recurring revenue opportunity with the potential to contribute to EBITDA growth over time. No mobile-operator distribution agreements have been executed in connection with this partnership as of the date of this release, and there can be no assurance that any such agreement will be entered into or that the partnership will generate revenue.

About IDILIO TV

IDILIO TV is a mobile-first entertainment platform producing premium vertical microdramas for Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide. Founded in Colombia and led by CEO and Co-Founder Gabriela Tafur and CTO and Co-Founder Esteban Ramírez, IDILIO TV combines Latin American storytelling with proprietary mobile technology and a mix of subscription, virtual-currency, advertising, and brand-partnership monetization. The Telecom Division is the foundation of IQSTEL's global platform, operating across 24 countries with more than 600 telecommunications carrier interconnections and delivering international voice, SMS, messaging, and connectivity solutions to some of the world's largest telecom operators and enterprise customers. Through these customer relationships, IQSTEL's platform has the potential to reach approximately 2.3 billion end users worldwide. Building on this global infrastructure and commercial reach, the Digital Services Division is focused on higher-margin technology solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Communications, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Digital Health, Enterprise Automation, and Content Services. releases.title: EMILY COMPAGNO NAMED CO-HOST OF FOX NEWS CHANNEL'S THE FIVE
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Channel's (FNC) The Five, the number one program in all of cable, has named Emily Compagno a full-time co-host, announced Suzanne Scott, CEO of FOX News Media. Compagno will officially join the program beginning September 8th alongside Greg Gutfeld, Dana Perino, Jesse Watters, as well as the rotating liberal seat featuring Harold Ford Jr. and Jessica Tarlov. She will relinquish her current role on Outnumbered (12-1 PM/ET) and a rotating FOX News personality will fill that seat until a permanent co-host is named.

In making the announcement, Ms. Scott said, "Fifteen years later, The Five remains a powerhouse and appointment viewing for millions of Americans. Emily is a highly accomplished host whose energy and talent have made her a standout across FOX News Media, and we are thrilled to officially welcome her to the show."

Compagno added, "I couldn't be more honored to join The Five, a team I have long admired and have been fortunate to work alongside over the years. Having an official seat at the table on what I truly believe is the most fun show on television is an incredible privilege. I am grateful for the opportunity and can't wait to get started."

The Five, which celebrated its 15-year anniversary in July 2026, has ruled its timeslot for more than a decade and remains one of the most dominant programs in all of television. During the second quarter of 2026, the program averaged 3.6 million viewers and 322,000 in the 25-54 demo, marking its 19th consecutive quarter as the highest-rated show in cable news. The Five also draws more Democratic viewers than CNN and MS NOW and ranks as the number one program across all of cable among Independents. Commanding more than 64% of the cable news audience in its time slot, the program routinely rivals and outpaces broadcast staples including Law & Order: SVU (3.7M), 9-1-1: Nashville (3.4M), Happy's Place (3.1M) and Abbott Elementary (2.6M).

Compagno joined FOX News as a contributor in 2018 and was named co-host of Outnumbered in 2021. The daily ensemble program, known for its signature debates among four women and "one lucky guy" ranks number one in its time slot and routinely outpaces several daytime offerings on the broadcast networks. She is also a bestselling author. Her inaugural title, Under His Wings, published by FOX News Books, debuted at number one on Amazon and the New York Times bestseller list in its first week. 

Prior to joining the network, Compagno practiced law in criminal defense and civil litigation and later served as a federal managing attorney and Acting Director at the Social Security Administration. She also served as a Senior Judge Judicial Extern for the late Hon. John T. Noonan at the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit and held legal positions in South Africa and Brazil. Compagno was also captain of the NFL's Oakland Raiders cheerleading squad and was selected as an NFL Ambassador, representing the league internationally and visiting U.S. troops in Iraq and Kuwait on a USO tour. She holds a B.A. in Political Science from the University of Washington and a J.D. from the University of San Francisco School of Law.

FOX News Channel (FNC) is a 24-hour all-encompassing news service and has been the number one network in basic cable for the last 10 years and the most-watched television news channel for more than 24 consecutive years, currently attracting nearly 60% of the cable news viewing audience according to Nielsen Media Research. Notably, Nielsen/MRI Fusion has consistently shown FNC to be the network of choice for more Democrat and Independent viewers, with the most politically diverse audience in cable news. A 2026 New York Times/Siena poll of registered voters found that FNC was the leading single source of news in the country, outranking all national television, cable and print/online organizations, while a 2024 Pew Research Center study found that more Americans named FNC as their main source for political news than any other network. FNC is available in more than 60 million homes including streaming on FOX One and dominates the cable news landscape, routinely notching the top 10 programs in the genre.
